verses.translation: I will stand upon my watch, and mount upon the rock, and watch to see what he will say by me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.

translations.ron: Voi sta de strajă şi mă voi aşeza în turnul cel de veghe ca să priveghez şi să văd ce-mi va grăi mie şi ce-mi va răspunde la tânguirea mea.
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ τῆς φυλακῆς μου στήσομαι, καὶ ἐπιβήσομαι ἐπὶ πέτραν, καὶ ἀποσκοπεύσω τοῦ ἰδεῖν τί λαλήσει ἐν ἐμοὶ, καὶ τί ἀποκριθῶ ἐπὶ τὸν ἔλεγχόν μου.

verses.translation: And the Lord answered me and said, Write the vision, and that plainly on a tablet, that he that reads it may run.

translations.ron: Şi Domnul mi-a răspuns şi mi-a zis: "Scrie vedenia şi o sapă cu slove pe table, ca să se poată citi uşor;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπεκρίθη πρὸς μὲ Κύριος, καὶ εἶπε, γράψον ὅρασιν, καὶ σαφῶς εἰς πυξίον, ὅπως διώκῃ ὁ ἀναγινώσκων αὐτά.

verses.translation: For the vision is yet for a time, and it shall shoot forth at the end, and not in vain: though he should tarry, wait for him; for he will surely come, and will not tarry.

translations.ron: Căci este o vedenie pentru un timp hotărât; ea se va împlini la vreme şi nu va fi vedenie mincinoasă. Dacă întârzie, aşteapt-o, căci ea va veni sigur, fără greş.
translations.grk: Διότι ἔτι ὅρασις εἰς καιρὸν, καὶ ἀνατελεῖ εἰς πέρας, καὶ οὐκ εἰς κενόν· ἐὰν ὑστερήσῃ, ὑπὸμεινον αὐτὸν, ὅτι ἐρχόμενος ἥξει, καὶ οὐ μὴ χρονίσῃ.

verses.translation: If he should draw back, my soul has no pleasure in him: but the just shall live by my faith.

translations.ron: Iată că va pieri acela al cărui suflet nu este pe calea cea dreaptă, iar dreptul din credinţă va fi viu!
translations.grk: Ἐὰν ὑποστείληται, οὐκ εὐδοκεῖ ἡ ψυχή μου ἐν αὐτῷ· ὁ δὲ δίκαιος ἐκ πίστεώς μου ζήσεται.

verses.translation: But the arrogant man and the scorner, the boastful man, shall not finish anything; who has enlarged his desire as the grave, and like death he is never satisfied, and he will gather to himself all the nations, and will receive to himself all the peoples.

translations.ron: Cât de mult va fi copleşit vrăjmaşul, omul cel trufaş, şi nu va rămâne cu viaţă el, care ţine gura lui căscată ca locuinţa morţilor şi nu se satură ca moartea; el, care adună toate neamurile şi cuprinde în el toate popoarele!
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ κατοιόμενος, καὶ καταφρονητὴς, ἀνὴρ ἀλαζὼν, οὐθὲν μὴ περάνῃ· ὃς ἐπλάτυνε καθὼς ᾅδης τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὗτος ὡς θάνατος οὐκ ἐμπιπλάμενος, καὶ ἐπισυνάξει ἐπʼ αὐτὸν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, καὶ εἰσδέξεται πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντας τοὺς λαούς.

verses.translation: Shall not all these take up a parable against him? and a proverb to tell against him? and they shall say, Woe to him that multiplies to himself the possessions which are not his! how long? and who heavily loads his yoke.

translations.ron: Oare toate aceste popoare nu vor rosti împotriva lui pilde, fabule şi cuvinte cu tâlc? şi vor zice: "Vai de cel ce-şi sporeşte averea cu ceea ce nu este al lui - până când? - şi se încarcă cu povara zălogurilor luate!
translations.grk: Οὐχὶ ταῦτα πάντα κατʼ αὐτοῦ παραβολὴν λήψονται, καὶ πρόβλημα εἰς διήγησιν αὐτοῦ; καὶ ἐροῦσιν, οὐαὶ ὁ πληθύνων ἑαυτῷ τὰ οὐκ ὄντα αὐτοῦ ἕως τίνος, καὶ βαρύνων τὸν κλοιὸν αὐτοῦ στιβαρῶς.

verses.translation: For suddenly there shall arise up those that bite him, and they that plot against thee shall awake, and thou shalt be a plunder to them.

translations.ron: Oare nu se vor scula fără de veste cei ce te-au împrumutat şi nu se vor trezi oare călăii tăi? Şi tu vei ajunge prada lor!
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐξαίφνης ἀναστήσονται δάκνοντες αὐτὸν, καὶ ἐκνήψουσιν οἱ ἐπίβουλοί σου, καὶ ἔσῃ εἰς διαρπαγὴν αὐτοῖς,

verses.translation: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the nations that are left shall spoil thee, because of the blood of men, and the sins of the land and city, and of all that dwell in it.

translations.ron: Şi fiindcă tu ai prădat popoare fără număr, şi celelalte neamuri te vor prăda pe tine, din pricina vărsărilor de sânge şi a silniciilor săvârşite împotriva ţării, împotriva cetăţii şi împotriva tuturor locuitorilor lor.
translations.grk: διότι ἐσκύλευσας ἔθνη πολλὰ, σκυλεύσουσι πάντες οἱ ὑπολελειμμένοι λαοὶ, διʼ αἵματα ἀνθρώπων, καὶ ἀσεβείας γῆς καὶ πόλεως, καὶ πάντων τῶν κατοικούντων αὐτήν.

verses.translation: Woe to him that covets an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evils.

translations.ron: Vai de cei ce strâng câştiguri nelegiuite pentru casa lor şi îşi aşează sus de tot cuibul, ca să scape din mâna nenorocirii!
translations.grk: Ὢ ὁ πλεονεκτῶν πλεονεξίαν κακὴν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ, τοῦ τάξαι εἰς ὕψος νοσσιὰν αὐτοῦ, τοῦ ἐκσπασθῆναι ἐκ χειρὸς κακῶν.

verses.translation: Thou hast devised shame to thy house, thou hast utterly destroyed many nations, and thy soul has sinned.

translations.ron: Prin sfaturile tale ai hărăzit ruşine casei tale, ai nimicit multe popoare şi de aceea vei ispăşi cu sufletul tău!
translations.grk: Ἐβουλεύσω αἰσχύνην τῷ οἴκῳ σου, συνεπέρανας πολλοὺς λαοὺς, καὶ ἐξήμαρτεν ἡ ψυχή σου.

verses.translation: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beetle out of the timber shall speak.

translations.ron: Căci piatra cea din zid strigă şi grinda din căpriorii casei îi răspunde.
translations.grk: Διότι λίθος ἐκ τοίχου βοήσεται, καὶ κάνθαρος ἐκ ξύλου φθέγξεται αὐτά.

verses.translation: Woe to him that builds a city with blood, and establishes a city by unrighteousness.

translations.ron: Vai de cel ce zideşte cetatea cu vărsări de sânge şi o întemeiază pe fărădelegi!
translations.grk: Οὐαὶ ὁ οἰκοδομῶν πόλιν ἐν αἵμασι, καὶ ἑτοιμάζων πόλιν ἐν ἀδικίαις.

verses.translation: Are not these things of the Lord Almighty? surely many people have been exhausted in the fire, and many nations have fainted.

translations.ron: Oare nu este aceasta o rânduială de la Domnul Savaot că popoarele se trudesc pentru foc şi neamurile se muncesc pentru nimica toată?
translations.grk: Οὐ ταῦτά ἐστι παρὰ Κυρίου παντοκράτορος; καὶ ἐξέλιπον λαοὶ ἱκανοὶ ἐν πυρὶ, καὶ ἔθνη πολλὰ ὠλιγοψύχησαν.

verses.translation: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord; it shall cover them as water.

translations.ron: Căci pământul se va umple de cunoştinţa slavei Domnului, întocmai ca apele care acoperă sânul mării.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐμπλησθήσεται ἡ γῆ τοῦ γνῶναι τὴν δόξαν Κυρίου, ὡς ὕδωρ κατακαλύψει αὐτούς.

verses.translation: Woe to him that gives his neighbour to drink the thick lees of wine, and intoxicates him, that he may look upon their secret parts.

translations.ron: Vai de cel ce adapă pe prietenul său din cupa lui otrăvită, până îl îmbată, ca să vadă goliciunea lui!
translations.grk: Ὢ ὁ ποτίζων τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ ἀνατροπῇ θολερᾷ, καὶ μεθύσκων ὅπως ἐπιβλέπῃ ἐπὶ τὰ σπήλαια αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: Drink thou also thy fill of disgrace instead of glory: shake, O heart, and quake, the cup of the right hand of the Lord has come round upon thee, and dishonour has gathered upon thy glory.

translations.ron: Tu te-ai săturat de ocară în loc de mărire; bea şi tu şi te îmbată! Atunci cupa dreptei Domnului se va întoarce împotriva ta şi ruşinea va acoperi mărirea ta.
translations.grk: Πλησμονὴν ἀτιμίας ἐκ δόξης πίε καὶ σύ· καρδία σαλεύθητι, καὶ σείσθητι· ἐκύκλωσεν ἐπὶ σὲ ποτήριον δεξιᾶς Κυρίου, καὶ συνήχθη ἀτιμία ἐπὶ τὴν δόξαν σου.

verses.translation: For the ungodliness of Libanus shall cover thee, and distress because of wild beasts shall dismay thee, because of the blood of men, and the sins of the land and city, and of all that dwell in it.

translations.ron: Căci silnicia împotriva Libanului te va acoperi şi distrugerea dobitoacelor te va înfricoşa din pricina sângelui vărsat şi a silniciilor făcute ţărilor şi cetăţilor şi tuturor locuitorilor din ele.
translations.grk: Διότι ἀσέβεια τοῦ Λιβάνου καλύψει σε, καὶ ταλαιπωρία θηρίων πτοήσει σε, διʼ αἵματα ἀνθρώπων, καὶ ἀσεβείας γῆς καὶ πόλεως, καὶ πάντων τῶν κατοικούντων αὐτήν.

verses.translation: What profits it the graven image, that they have graven it? one has made it a molten work, a false image; for the maker has trusted in his work, to make dumb idols.

translations.ron: La ce slujeşte un chip cioplit, ca să-l facă meşterul său? Un chip turnat şi o proorocie mincinoasă, ca să-şi pună nădejdea în ele cel care le face, făurind idoli fără glas?
translations.grk: Τί ὠφελεῖ γλυπτὸν, ὅτι ἔγλυψαν αὐτό; ἔπλασεν αὐτὸ χώνευμα, φαντασίαν ψευδῆ, ὅτι πέποιθεν ὁ πλάσας ἐπὶ τὸ πλάσμα αὐτοῦ, τοῦ ποιῆσαι εἴδωλα κωφά.

verses.translation: Woe to him that says to the wood, Awake, arise; and to the stone, Be thou exalted! whereas it is an image, and this is a casting of gold and silver, and there is no breath in it.

translations.ron: Vai de cel care zice lemnului: "Deşteaptă-te!" şi pietrei mute: "Trezeşte-te!" Ne poate ea învăţa? Poleită cu aur şi cu argint, ea nu are în ea suflare de viaţă.
translations.grk: Οὐαὶ ὁ λέγων τῷ ξύλῳ, ἔκνηψον, ἐξεγέρθητι· καὶ τῷ λίθῳ, ὑψώθητι· καὶ αὐτό ἐστι φαντασία· τοῦτο δέ ἐστιν ἔλασμα χρυσίου καὶ ἀργυρίου, καὶ πᾶν πνεῦμα οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτῷ.

verses.translation: But the Lord is in his holy temple: let all the earth fear before him.

translations.ron: Dar Domnul este în templul Său cel sfânt; pământule întreg, taci înaintea Lui!
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ Κύριος ἐν ναῷ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ· εὐλαβείσθω ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ.
